qual-w1-lockout._note: Hexworth Qualifier round 1. COMPETITION box: deliveryDisabled means deliverFlag never discloses a value, and mission_gates/qual-w1-lockout requires server-re-derived findings, so a correct guess without the work is refused. THE ANSWER IS THE DEVICE NAME, NOT THE IP, DELIBERATELY: an adversarial audit proved that when the flag equalled the gate's shared-axis value (192.168.1.150), verifyFinding's success message handed it back. The echo is fixed at source, but the flag must also not BE a value the gate handles. Naming the device requires the physical inventory - which is the corroborator the gate already demands - so the answer now costs one step more than log correlation, which is better pedagogy as well as a smaller blast radius. The ad001-lockout-storm TEACHING box is separate and still discloses its flag.
